tested_scope: Exactly one bounded self-local deterministic idempotency-key reconstruction check. The key input is limited to the frozen Phase-1/root/task identity, current DESIRED_STATE blob, current multi_agent role-config blob, immediate predecessor LATEST blob, a fixed leaf id, and a fixed intended effect descriptor. The same canonical JSON was reconstructed from two different in-memory insertion orders using sorted keys and compact separators, then SHA-256 hashed. No external/public source, other role, O/downstream state, scheduler state, or second semantic leaf was used.

claim_epoch_derivation.rule: Mechanical role-local checkpoint lineage only: successor observes explicit predecessor claim_epoch=n, sets n+1, and CAS-updates LATEST from that exact predecessor blob.

observations: The current frozen semantic authority remains DESIRED_STATE control27 blob 0eee15a94c23400653d84506da1f795081a6ef24 and multi_agent config10/control13 blob 37a44cd0a2556a782247210bdd2c557ee58fe133 at frozen main commit 1e701285fb7b9881547cdcc4736250d86a9cf7d6.
The required config10 presemantic role-local witness was written and exact-read back before the semantic state read.

Canonicalizing the same intended effect from two distinct in-memory key insertion orders produced identical canonical bytes and identical SHA-256 digest bb269114c6d7386c72cf0531701c9982b7081935abff9f1f2ab3b648c8c87b17.

Because the predecessor LATEST blob is included in the key input, a retry of this exact intended effect against the same predecessor can reconstruct the same key, while a later distinct successor effect after LATEST advances is forced onto a different predecessor identity.
inference: This bounded fixture establishes deterministic self-local idempotency-key derivation for one exact claim effect under the frozen authority tuple. It does not establish duplicate rejection by GitHub, stale-CAS rejection, simultaneous-writer exclusion, fairness, lease expiry/reclamation, or rate-limit interruption safety. Those children remain open.
unresolved_children: Replay the stored canonical_input on a later invocation and verify the same digest is reconstructed across the invocation boundary without performing the side effect; this tests cross-run retry-key stability rather than same-run determinism only.

Test intentional stale-CAS rejection only when one invocation can perform the rejected write and still durably persist/read back its outcome within the lifecycle write budget, or when current role-local authority explicitly names a safe non-writing proof surface.
Test create-if-absent duplicate rejection only when the rejected attempt and durable result checkpoint can both fit within the bounded write budget.
Simultaneous competing CAS writers, fairness, lease expiry/reclamation, and rate-limit interruption behavior remain untested.
